description: bare `context` used as a whole record value (==, !=, has)

tests.name: context_equals_itself_empty
tests.description: an unset context materialises as the empty record, so context == context holds
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { context == context };

tests.name: context_equals_itself_populated
tests.description: context == context holds when context carries attributes
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { context == context };

tests.name: context_equals_matching_literal
tests.description: context compares equal to a record literal with the same fields
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { context == {a: 1, b: "x"} };

tests.name: context_equals_literal_value_mismatch
tests.description: context differs from a literal when a field value differs
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { context == {a: 2, b: "x"} };

tests.name: context_equals_literal_size_mismatch
tests.description: context differs from a literal of different size

tests.name: context_empty_equals_empty_literal
tests.description: an unset context equals the empty record literal

tests.name: context_not_equals_literal
tests.description: context != literal is true when they differ, so permit applies

tests.name: context_not_equals_matching_literal_denies
tests.description: context != literal is false when they match, so permit does not apply

tests.name: bare_context_has_present
tests.description: `context has field` on the whole record is true when the field exists
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { context has a };

tests.name: bare_context_has_absent
tests.description: `context has field` is false when the field is absent
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { context has missing };
